summary: Frontend-only verification on the Operations DashboardPage as owner@isodemo.com of: (1) CRITICAL — Log-a-Fault dialog should stay OPEN when a photo/video is added, (2) Equipment card traffic-light left borders, (3) Operations header consistency 'Operations · Iso Demo Fitness' + date on the right. TEST 2 and TEST 3 PASS. TEST 1 PARTIAL — first photo upload now correctly keeps the dialog open (original Radix interact-outside bug is fixed), but a SECOND set_input_files call causes the dialog to CLOSE.

ui_bugs.issue: Log-a-Fault dialog still closes when a SECOND photo/video is added. After the 1st `set_input_files` on data-testid='issue-media-input', the dialog stays open and the file chip appears (chip count=1, dialog count=1). After the 2nd `set_input_files` on the SAME input, the dialog count drops to 0 (we land back on the Faults list). The PRD explicitly says: 'Add a second file and confirm it appends.' The first-upload critical bug appears fixed via onInteractOutside/onPointerDownOutside preventDefault, but the second upload still trips a close path — likely a focus/blur event (onFocusOutside) that Radix interprets as outside-interaction. Suggested fix: also add onFocusOutside={(e)=>e.preventDefault()} on DialogContent, and/or ensure the hidden <input type='file'> click does not bubble (e.g. wrap in a controlled handler that calls e.stopPropagation on focus/blur).

tests_executed.details: Faults sub-tab → 'Log New Fault' opens issue-dialog. 1st set_input_files(test_photo1.png) → issue-dialog count=1 (OPEN), chip 'photoA_*.png' present (count=1) ✅. 2nd set_input_files(test_photo2.png) → issue-dialog count=0 (CLOSED) ❌, both chips gone. Screenshot .screenshots/dialog_uploaded.png shows we're back on the Faults list. The 1st-photo close (the originally reported CRITICAL bug) is resolved, but the multi-photo case still closes the dialog. Remove ✕ button could not be tested because the dialog was already closed after the 2nd upload.

Equipment sub-tab shows 2 cards (equipment-card-2588d6a7-... and equipment-card-5143ead7-...). Both render computed borderLeftColor=rgb(196, 196, 204) with borderLeftWidth=4px — the neutral/grey traffic-light state (no warranty_expiry/sla_expiry on seeded equipment), matching spec. Border is rendered via class (not inline style), 4px-wide. Other colour states (green/amber/red) depend on seeded dates that are not present, so only the grey state is observable; the styling system is wired up correctly.

data-testid='dashboard-title' renders 'Operations · Iso Demo Fitness' (note: small-glyph 'Operations·' with non-breaking middle dot) and data-testid='dashboard-date' renders 'Monday, 29 June 2026' on the right. Verified on ALL sub-tabs: Start, Dashboard, Equipment, Faults — the module title is preserved regardless of active sub-tab. Subtitle 'Equipment, faults, maintenance & compliance — your whole estate in one place.' also visible. Header layout matches Comms/Memberships header pattern.

action_items: HIGH PRIORITY — Fix Log-a-Fault dialog closing on the SECOND photo/video upload. Add `onFocusOutside={(e)=>e.preventDefault()}` to <DialogContent> in /app/frontend/src/pages/Dashboard/FaultDialogs.js (~L57-58) in addition to the existing onInteractOutside / onPointerDownOutside handlers. Radix Dialog also dispatches an `onFocusOutside` event when the OS file picker steals focus, which is the most likely root cause for the second-upload close.

Optional — confirm traffic-light green/amber/red borders by seeding equipment with warranty_expiry (current) / warranty_expiry (within 60d) / warranty_expiry (past) — current seed only exercises the grey/no-cover branch.

Optional A11y — the dialog-title text uses 'Operations· Iso Demo Fitness' (no space before middle dot in the rendered text). The PRD example shows 'Operations · Iso Demo Fitness' (space-dot-space). Cosmetic — verify with main agent if this is intentional.
critical_code_review_comments: FaultDialogs.js L57-58: onInteractOutside + onPointerDownOutside preventDefault is the right starting move, but does not cover focus-shift caused by the OS file picker. Per Radix docs, onFocusOutside is a SEPARATE event from onPointerDownOutside; both should be guarded for file-input scenarios.

Consider an explicit attachment-list re-render guard: when setIssueMedia([...prev, ...files]) runs, ensure the input.value reset (e.target.value = '') happens BEFORE the state update so the input doesn't transiently re-trigger focus events that Radix interprets as outside-interaction.

rca_of_the_issue: Original Radix Dialog close-on-file-picker bug (1st upload) is fixed by onInteractOutside+onPointerDownOutside preventDefault. Remaining issue (2nd upload closes the dialog) is most likely caused by Radix's onFocusOutside handler firing when focus returns from the OS file picker the second time — onPointerDownOutside is dispatched on pointer events, NOT on focus changes. Fix: add `onFocusOutside={(e) => e.preventDefault()}` to <DialogContent> alongside the existing two handlers.
